extras: Beer and wine are available at an additional charge

Optional island-wide pickup: a car carries up to 5 guests for USD 75; a van carries up to 9 guests for USD 125 per van. All adults, children and infants count toward capacity. Groups above 9 need transport reviewed by the team. Pickup is one hour before arrival/check-in, in Curaçao local time.

policies.cancellation: DEMO POLICY - REPLACE BEFORE GO-LIVE: Cancel or request a change at least 48 hours before departure. Later cancellations and no-shows are non-refundable in this demonstration.
policies.safety: DEMO POLICY - REPLACE BEFORE GO-LIVE: Participation is at the guest's own risk and instructions from the captain and crew must be followed. This demonstration does not state or verify insurance coverage.
policies.insurance: Insurance coverage is not verified in this demonstration. Mermaid must approve final insurance wording before go-live.
